Definition: a Pirathonite or inhabitant of Pirathon
BiblicalUsage: A Pirathonite is an inhabitant of Pirathon. Benaiah the Pirathonite stands among David's mighty men in 2 Samuel 23:30 and commands the eleventh course in 1 Chronicles 27:14, and Abdon the Pirathonite judged Israel in Judges 12:13.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a man's town is part of his name in Scripture — where he came from is remembered with what he did.
